spans.text: Ramtintian ii minung covo thuthan nak cu, mikip le pawl kom tintian ah ruat ring ring ii lei lung tlun pumpuluk ah a cui minung kip ii covo, zalen nak pawl hi upat ciou dingah, folh fial nak thawn kan zuam ciouding ti in siseh, UNO sungtel ram pawl le cui ram pawl ii thu nei tupawl ih uk nak sungah ram mi pawl hnen ah cui covo le zalen nak khi kau zet le sung lawi zet ii thlun ciou dingah, ramsung ram leng tiang in zuam ciou ding ah siseh, Ram tintian ii covo, thuthan mikha ram tintian, mikip in bangrep ten tuan ciou dingah hi ti in kan than a si.

folded.id: si nak|ah|siseh
folded.subject: si nak
folded.object: siseh

spans.text: Miphun hmuah hmuah hnen ah siseh, midum mirang hnen ah siseh, nu lepa si nak ah siseh, tong phun ruang ah siseh, biak nak ruangah siseh, ram duh dawt nak a phun phun ah siseh ramle pom dan dang dang ruang ah siseah, suah nak in simaw ?
Cui tlun ah minung pakhat ii ramduh dawt nak cu thu then nak lam ah siseh, ram pakhat le pakhat pawlkom nak ah siseh, hleidan nak um hlah seh.

Zozo khal amai pumpaak thu in zalawng zet ih umcaan nak ah siseh, mai innsung sang ah siseh, mai inn kiangkap ah siseh, ca kuat awk nak ah siseh,daan um lo vek in mawh phur nak um hram hlah seh.Cui tlunah mai si nak khal aa soisel nak um hram hlah seh.
Mikip in cutivek sim siat nak le soisel hmuh suam nak ah siseh , daan in humhim haiseh.
Mikip in mai um nak ramsung ah siseh, ramdang ahsiseh, tlawn theih nak kan neih tlun ah mai ram ah kan tlung sal thei asi.
Kum kim ciami nunau le mipa pawl in mipum sinakah siseh, ram mi si nak ah siseh, biak nak thu ah siseh hlei dan awk nak um lo in thit aw theih nak le innsang din thei nak an nei asi.

Cui covo pawl par ah maiduh mi biak nak le zum nak ah kan thleng dual do thei nak kan nei ih tlun ah mah bulpaak in siseh, midang thawn akom in siseh, ram mi hmaiah siseh, rammi um lo nak ah siseh mai biak nak le zum nak cu zalen zet in simfiang theih nak, man thei nak, biakkhawm thei nak le biak inn sak thei nak tla kan nei ciou asi.

folded.id: si nak|ii|sin an tlan san thei lo
folded.subject: si nak
folded.object: sin an tlan san thei lo

spans.text: Thlunding daan asilo ahcun rammi si nak ii sin an tlan san thei lo.

folded.id: suh tik|ah|bangrep theh haiseh
folded.subject: suh tik
folded.object: bangrep theh haiseh

spans.text: Covo miparah le tuanding mi thu ii relcat mipar ah siseh, sual nak pakhat khat ii ruang ah thuthen nak parah siseh, mikip in za len zet in tan mi bul um lo in thu then nak zungah thu suh tik ah bangrep theh haiseh.

folded.id: that ruang|ah|simaw?
folded.subject: that ruang
folded.object: simaw?

spans.text: Len le that ruang ah simaw?

folded.id: thei lo|ii|ruangah meithar thawn tan nak
folded.subject: thei lo
folded.object: ruangah meithar thawn tan nak

spans.text: Mi hmuah hmuah in daan um mumal lo, nen niam duh nak lungput, hmuh suam zomh taih nak pawl kha ti-ngaih nak dang a um thei lo ii ruangah meithar thawn tan nak, dodal nak um lo in minung pakhat ciar ii thil ti theinak kha hum him atul ruangah siseh,

folded.id: thlunding daan|thawn|kalh aw in kaih hrem nak asimaw
folded.subject: thlunding daan
folded.object: kalh aw in kaih hrem nak asimaw

spans.text: Zozo khal thlunding daan thawn kalh aw in kaih hrem nak asimaw, thongh inn ih ret nak asi maw, ram ih sin dawi pet nak simaw um hram hlah seh.

folded.id: thu hla|ah|a tlun in covo cu nei hlah hai seh
folded.subject: thu hla
folded.object: a tlun in covo cu nei hlah hai seh

spans.text: Ram thu hla thawn a seng lo mi mawh phurh nak ah siseh, UNO ii tumtak mithawn a karh aw mi thu hla siseh, an suar ruang ih mawh phurh mipawl thu hla ah a tlun in covo cu nei hlah hai seh.

folded.id: thu hla|thawn|a seng lo mi mawh phurh nak ah siseh
folded.subject: thu hla
folded.object: a seng lo mi mawh phurh nak ah siseh

spans.text: Ram thu hla thawn a seng lo mi mawh phurh nak ah siseh, UNO ii tumtak mithawn a karh aw mi thu hla siseh, an suar ruang ih mawh phurh mipawl thu hla ah a tlun in covo cu nei hlah hai seh.

folded.id: tin tian|iium|minung pakhat ciar ii covo thuthan
folded.subject: Tin Tian
folded.object: Minung Pakhat ciar ii Covo Thuthan

spans.text: Ram Tin Tian iium Minung Pakhat ciar ii Covo Thuthan

folded.id: tlun pumpuluk|ah|upat nak thawn peh zom vivo ding ah kan tiam kamzo a si bang tuk in siseh
folded.subject: tlun pumpuluk
folded.object: upat nak thawn peh zom vivo ding ah kan tiam kamzo a si bang tuk in siseh

spans.text: UNO sungtel ram pawl ii UNO thawn peh zom ii minung pawl zalen nak lam ah siseh, ahrampi in minung pakhat ciar ii covo lam ah siseh, leilung tlun pumpuluk ah upat nak thawn peh zom vivo ding ah kan tiam kamzo a si bang tuk in siseh;
Cui tlun ah minung pakhat ii ramduh dawt nak cu thu then nak lam ah siseh, ram pakhat le pakhat pawlkom nak ah siseh, hleidan nak um hlah seh.

Mipakhat khat cu ram ih tuah mi daan parah siseh, leilung tlun thlun ding daan parah siseh, a sual nak alang fiang hlan lo, cu a si lo le a um lo kar lakah mawh phurh si hlah seh; Cui tlun ah a sual lai ling ah a sual nak ii phu nak in a hnadeuh thuthen nak um hram hlah seh.
Mikip in mai um nak ramsung ah siseh, ramdang ahsiseh, tlawn theih nak kan neih tlun ah mai ram ah kan tlung sal thei asi.

folded.id: um tikkhal|ah|siseh
folded.subject: um tikkhal
folded.object: siseh

spans.text: Cui inn sang an si hnuah siseh, inn sang then awk nak a um tikkhal ah siseh, thitum neih awk nak thu ah, nunau le mipaii covo bangrep ten a ngah a tul asi.

folded.id: uno|ah|sungrtel ram pawl ii kan covo ciouah siseh
folded.subject: UNO
folded.object: sungrtel ram pawl ii kan covo ciouah siseh

spans.text: UNO ah sungrtel ram pawl ii kan covo ciouah siseh, minung sun lawih nak siseh, mipa nunau hlei dan lo ding thu ah siseh, tipawl kha thupi ah neih ding kan hnemnget ih hlei ah minung nuncan khua sak tha sin ii, zalen nak khal um sin, khaisang sinding ah kan tiam kam mi par ah siseh,

folded.id: uno|ii|kilkhawi nak ram
folded.subject: UNO
folded.object: kilkhawi nak ram

spans.text: Hmun leram pakhat ii zalawngzet ii um thei nak ram, UNO ii kilkhawi nak ram, mai thu in nun khua sak dan a hrek tluk lawng ngah nak ram ti-in hleidan nak um hrim hrim hlah seh.

folded.id: uno|ii|tumtak mithawn a karh aw mi thu hla siseh
folded.subject: UNO
folded.object: tumtak mithawn a karh aw mi thu hla siseh

spans.text: Ram thu hla thawn a seng lo mi mawh phurh nak ah siseh, UNO ii tumtak mithawn a karh aw mi thu hla siseh, an suar ruang ih mawh phurh mipawl thu hla ah a tlun in covo cu nei hlah hai seh.

Ramtintian ii minung covo thuthan nak cu, mikip le pawl kom tintian ah ruat ring ring ii lei lung tlun pumpuluk ah a cui minung kip ii covo, zalen nak pawl hi upat ciou dingah, folh fial nak thawn kan zuam ciouding ti in siseh, UNO sungtel ram pawl le cui ram pawl ii thu nei tupawl ih uk nak sungah ram mi pawl hnen ah cui covo le zalen nak khi kau zet le sung lawi zet ii thlun ciou dingah, ramsung ram leng tiang in zuam ciou ding ah siseh, Ram tintian ii covo, thuthan mikha ram tintian, mikip in bangrep ten tuan ciou dingah hi ti in kan than a si.

folded.id: zalen zet|ii|nun khua sak theinak leilung pi a can thei nak dingah mi phun kip ii atul bik miduh san nak kha simthan zo a si mi tlun ah siseh
folded.subject: zalen zet
folded.object: nun khua sak theinak leilung pi a can thei nak dingah mi phun kip ii atul bik miduh san nak kha simthan zo a si mi tlun ah siseh

spans.text: Mi hmuah hmuah ii miphun sunloih nak thawn mikip ii bangrep ii covo kan neih mipawl kan sunsak awk hi mi hmuah hmuah ii thu neih nak thu neih bangrep nak, daih nak timipawl hi athu pi tawdaap a si ih hrangah siseh, mi nung pakhat ciar ii thil ti thei nak ziang siar lo nak ihsin mikip siat suah duh nak asuah ter ruang ah siseh, zalen tak ih sim thei nak, zalen zet in maiduh mi zum thei nak, tih phan nak, nunhar nak it sin zalen zet ii nun khua sak theinak leilung pi a can thei nak dingah mi phun kip ii atul bik miduh san nak kha simthan zo a si mi tlun ah siseh,
